name: io.github.SarutobiSasuke8/credential-broker-mcp
title: Credential Broker
description: Local-first credential broker: agents use gated APIs through scoped, audited requests, never keys.

environmentVariables.name: BROKER_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Which agent identity this process is. Must be provisioned in the policy file.

environmentVariables.name: BROKER_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the policy YAML (version 2). Defaults to config/broker.yaml.

environmentVariables.name: BROKER_AUDIT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the content-free audit log. Defaults to data/audit.jsonl.

environmentVariables.name: BROKER_APPROVALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the approvals file. Defaults to config/approvals.json.

environmentVariables.name: BROKER_HOT_RELOAD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to pick up key manager changes without a restart. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: BROKER_ALLOW_KEY_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let this agent ask the operator for a key through the key manager. Off by default.
